# Current CLI transcript fixtures

Captured on Linux x86-64 on 2026-10-29 from official OpenCode 2.2.1 and Pi
1.4.0 binaries with isolated homes and deterministic loopback mock providers.
No real account, model request, or billing is involved. Token/cost values are
synthetic. These are complete stdout captures, not invented adapter events.
Pi executed the built-in read tool against a disposable sentinel file.
Source and binary provenance: [audit](../../../docs/harness-refresh-2026-10.md).
